description: This file defines the Currency controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, providing functionality to list, install, and uninstall currency extensions within the administrative backend.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency extensions in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of installed and available currency extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a new currency extension, setting permissions and registering necessary components.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a currency extension and triggers related cleanup actions.
